artifacts.summary: Re-derives all four recorded grounds for declining the pre-postflight-sweep deploy trigger against the current tree (unchanged), prices ground (c) with a corpus-wide measurement (68/396 completed meta tasks, 59 git-paired wall-clock deltas), and recommends REAFFIRM with an exact, ready-to-apply dated amendment paragraph for the plan/implement phases.

memory_candidates.content: When pricing a 'cost removed by mechanism X' claim in this codebase, pair the self-reported issues.jsonl class entries with git-commit-message pairing (e.g. 'task N: orchestration paused (cycle C)' / 'task N: complete implementation (post-deploy reconcile)') across `git log --all --format="%H|%ad|%s"`. The two sources corroborate each other and the commit-message pairing gives precise wall-clock deltas the issue log alone does not carry.

In this repository's /orchestrate completion-deploy-gate deferral pattern, the large-magnitude outliers in paused-to-reconciled wall-clock deltas are overwhelmingly cross-session resume gaps (a new /orchestrate invocation started much later), not within-session cycle-boundary delays. Any future cost analysis of this gate should separate same-session deltas (typically ~5-6 min median) from cross-session deltas (which can span hours to days) before averaging, since a blended mean is dominated by the latter and misrepresents the mechanism's actual per-cycle cost.
